reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Persons eligible to reserve limited partnership name
headings.reviewNote: Specifies entities and persons entitled to reserve limited partnership name.

headings.title: Application procedure, duration, and transfer of reserved name
headings.reviewNote: Governs reservation filing, 60-day period up to 180-day maximum, and notice of transfer.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 2004); LP name reservation eligibility, § 417.210 check, 60-day/180-day cap, and transfer verified.

headings.title: Maintenance of registered office and agent
headings.reviewNote: Requires continuous maintenance of registered office and registered agent in Missouri.

headings.title: Statement of change of registered office or agent
headings.reviewNote: Specifies contents of statement to change registered office address or registered agent.

headings.title: Execution and delivery of statement of change
headings.reviewNote: Requires general partner execution under penalty of perjury and delivery in duplicate.

headings.title: Effective date of change and deemed county residence
headings.reviewNote: Sets effective date upon filing and deems partnership residence in county of registered office.

headings.title: Change of business address by registered agent
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registered agent to change registered office address by statement after notice.

headings.title: Secretary of state as service agent upon default
headings.reviewNote: Appoints secretary of state as automatic agent for service upon default.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985–2004); tightened subsection 6 title; continuous office/agent maintenance, § 575.040 affirmation, agent address change, and default service rules verified.

headings.title: Records required to be kept
headings.reviewNote: Lists records each limited partnership must keep, including partner lists, certificates, three-year tax and financial records, and contribution writings.

headings.title: Partner inspection rights and secretary of state demand
headings.reviewNote: Subjects records to partner inspection and authorizes secretary of state request for partner lists.

headings.title: Sanctions for failure to deliver partner list
headings.reviewNote: Subjects a general partner to possible $50/day civil penalty up to $10,000 and class A misdemeanor prosecution for failing to deliver partner list within 20 days of written demand.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); corrected subsection 1 title to remove unstated 'at registered office' location; inspection, demand, and 20-day general partner sanctions verified.

headings.title: Contents of certificate of limited partnership
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents including name, registered office, general partners, and duration.

headings.title: Formation date upon filing or specified time
headings.reviewNote: Sets formation upon filing with secretary of state or any other specified time if substantial compliance is met.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985–2000); certificate contents and formation timing upon substantial compliance verified.

headings.title: Contents of certificate of amendment
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents of certificate of amendment filed with secretary of state.

headings.title: Mandatory amendment within thirty days
headings.reviewNote: Requires amendment within thirty days for admission or withdrawal of general partner or continuation.

headings.title: Duty to promptly correct false or changed statements
headings.reviewNote: Imposes affirmative duty on general partner to amend inaccurate certificate promptly.

headings.title: Permissive amendments for proper purposes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes amendment at any time for proper purposes determined by partners.

headings.title: Safe harbor for amendments filed within thirty days
headings.reviewNote: Shields persons from liability if mandatory amendment is filed within thirty days.

headings.title: Restated certificate of limited partnership
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes execution and filing of restated certificate in same manner as amendment.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); amendment contents, 30-day mandatory events and safe harbor, prompt correction duty, permissive amendments, and restated certificates verified.

headings.title: Execution requirements for certificates
headings.reviewNote: Specifies signing requirements for original, amendment, and cancellation certificates.

headings.title: Signature by attorney-in-fact
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes signature by attorney-in-fact with specific description for general partner admission.

headings.title: Affirmation of truth under statutory penalties
headings.reviewNote: Deems general partner execution an affirmation of truth under section 575.040.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985–2004); certificate signing requirements, attorney-in-fact execution, and § 575.040 affirmation verified.

headings.title: Filing procedure and duties of secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Specifies delivery, endorsement, filing of original, and return of copy.

headings.title: Effective date of amendment or cancellation
headings.reviewNote: Governs effective date upon filing or delayed date up to ninety days after filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 2004); secretary of state filing duties and effective date (up to 90-day delay) verified.

headings.title: Statement of correction authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes filing statement of correction for documents containing incorrect statements.

headings.title: Contents of statement of correction
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required contents, reasons, and foreign existence certificate where name corrected.

headings.title: Effective date of statement of correction
headings.reviewNote: Provides 'articles of correction' (source wording) relate back to original effective date except as to adversely affected relying persons.

headings.title: Filing fee for statement of correction
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five-dollar filing fee collected by secretary of state.

headings.title: Execution of statement of correction
headings.reviewNote: Requires execution by an authorized person (source text verbatim reads 'limited liability partnership' within this chapter 359 section).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 2004 source note; statement of correction rules and $5 fee verified (verbatim 'articles of correction' in sub 3 and 'limited liability partnership' in sub 5 noted).

headings.title: Authorization for merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes domestic limited partnership to merge or consolidate with limited partnerships or other entities.

headings.title: Partner approval required for merger agreement
headings.reviewNote: Establishes required percentage of general and limited partners to approve merger agreement.

headings.title: Articles of merger or consolidation contents
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required terms and disclosures in articles of merger or consolidation.

headings.title: Execution of certificate of merger or consolidation
headings.reviewNote: Requires execution of the 'certificate of merger or consolidation' (source wording) by at least one general partner of each domestic LP and an authorized agent.

headings.title: Surviving domestic limited partnership certificate amendment
headings.reviewNote: Amends surviving certificate and cancels non-surviving domestic limited partnership certificates.

headings.title: Service of process for non-domestic surviving entity
headings.reviewNote: Requires foreign surviving or resulting LP to attach irrevocable secretary of state service appointment and mailing address (source reads 'mailed ... to the secretary of state').

headings.title: Vesting of rights, property, and assumption of liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Vests property and causes of action in survivor while preserving creditor rights and liens.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1993–2003); domestic LP merger/consolidation rules verified (verbatim 'certificate' in sub 4 and 'to the secretary of state' wording in sub 6 noted).

headings.title: Requirements to become and continue as registered LLLP
headings.reviewNote: Sets application, voting approval, chapter 358 compliance, and LLLP name designation.

headings.title: Execution and partner references for LLLP filings
headings.reviewNote: Requires general partner execution and restricts partner references to general partners.

headings.title: Limitation on partner liability
headings.reviewNote: Accords partners limited liability protections of chapter 358 registered LLPs.

headings.title: Name amendment, penalties, and administrative correction
headings.reviewNote: Mandates name correction upon cessation, imposing monthly civil penalties and class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1997, 2004); LLLP qualification under §§ 358.440–358.501, liability shield, and 90-day cessation name-change penalties (§ 359.691 class B misdemeanor) verified.

headings.title: Effective date of becoming a limited partner
headings.reviewNote: Sets timing on filing original certificate or date stated in partnership records.

headings.title: Admission of additional limited partners
headings.reviewNote: Governs admission directly from partnership or through assignee power under section 359.431.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); effective date of limited partner status and additional limited partner admission under § 359.431 verified.

headings.title: Relief for person erroneously believing limited partner status
headings.reviewNote: Relieves person from general partner liability upon corrective filing or certificate of withdrawal.

headings.title: Liability to third parties believing general partner status
headings.reviewNote: Imposes general partner liability to third parties who actually believed in good faith the person was a general partner before withdrawal or corrective filing.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); tightened both titles and aligned subsection 2 note with statutory 'actually believed in good faith' standard.

headings.title: Rights and powers of general partner
headings.reviewNote: Provides general partner has rights, powers, and restrictions of partner without limited partners.

headings.title: Liabilities of a general partner
headings.reviewNote: Imposes general partner liabilities to third parties and to partnership and other partners.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1985 note (effective 1-01-87); tightened subsection 2 title; general partner rights, powers, restrictions, and liabilities verified.

headings.title: Enforceability of promise to contribute
headings.reviewNote: Requires signed writing for limited partner contribution promise to be enforceable.

headings.title: Obligation to contribute and cash substitute option
headings.reviewNote: Enforces contribution obligations despite death or disability and provides cash substitute option.

headings.title: Compromise of contribution obligation and creditor rights
headings.reviewNote: Requires unanimous consent to compromise and preserves creditor enforcement rights.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); signed-writing requirement, contribution enforcement with cash substitute under § 359.051, and unanimous compromise with creditor reliance verified.

headings.title: One-year liability for rightful return of contribution
headings.reviewNote: Imposes one-year liability for rightful return to discharge existing creditor claims.

headings.title: Six-year liability for wrongful return of contribution
headings.reviewNote: Imposes six-year liability for return received in violation of agreement or statute.

headings.title: Definition of return of contribution
headings.reviewNote: Defines return as distribution reducing share of net assets below unreturned value.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); one-year rightful return liability, six-year wrongful return liability, and return definition under § 359.051 verified.

headings.title: Conditions for assignee to become limited partner
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes assignee to become limited partner by agreement authority or unanimous consent.

headings.title: Rights, powers, restrictions, and liabilities of assignee
headings.reviewNote: Grants assignee rights and liabilities of limited partner while exempting unknown liabilities.

headings.title: Non-release of assignor liability
headings.reviewNote: Maintains assignor liability for false statements and required contributions.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); assignee admission as limited partner, assumed/excluded liabilities under § 359.391, and non-release of assignor under §§ 359.151 and 359.291 verified.

headings.title: Priority order for asset distribution upon winding up
headings.reviewNote: Directs asset distribution priority to creditors, distribution debts, and partner contributions.

headings.title: Disposal of unknown claims by published notice
headings.reviewNote: Permits disposing of unknown claims by filing and publishing a notice of winding up with a three-year bar (subdivision (1) verbatim reads 'corporation's principal office').

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 2000); tightened subsection 1 title; winding-up priority under §§ 359.321/359.351 and unknown-claim published notice bar verified (verbatim 'corporation's principal office' in sub 2(1) noted).

headings.title: Duties of secretary of state upon registration application
headings.reviewNote: Specifies endorsement, filing, and issuance of certificate of registration.

headings.title: Return of certificate of registration to filer
headings.reviewNote: Directs return of certificate and copy to applicant or representative.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and 1985 note (effective 1-01-87); secretary of state endorsement, filing, and certificate return duties verified.

headings.title: Mandatory amended certificate of registration for foreign LP
headings.reviewNote: Requires amended certificate for changes in name, jurisdiction, offices, or general partner.

headings.title: Certificate of existence requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires authenticated certificate of existence dated within sixty days from home jurisdiction.

headings.title: Filing fee for amended certificate of registration
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-dollar filing fee for amended foreign certificate.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 2004); foreign LP mandatory amended registration, 60-day certificate of existence, and $20 fee verified.

headings.title: Fine, prosecutor referral, and court action bar
headings.reviewNote: Imposes fine of not less than $1,000, secretary of state referral after August 1 to prosecuting attorney, and bar on maintaining Missouri court actions while noncompliant.

headings.title: Validity of contracts and right to defend suits
headings.reviewNote: Preserves validity of contracts and permits defending suits despite failure to register.

headings.title: Limited partner liability protection preserved
headings.reviewNote: Protects limited partners from general partner liability solely for transacting business without registration.

headings.title: Personal jurisdiction under long-arm statute
headings.reviewNote: Subjects unregistered foreign LP to personal jurisdiction under sections 506.500 to 506.520.

headings.title: Activities not constituting transacting business
headings.reviewNote: Lists non-transacting activities including lawsuits, meetings, bank accounts, and isolated transactions.

headings.title: Foreign corporate partner status
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies a foreign corporation under § 351.015 is not transacting business for § 351.570 solely by being a partner of a limited partnership.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985, 1990); tightened subsection 1 title and corrected notes on 'not less than' $1,000 fine and subsection 6 applying to a foreign corporation that is a 'partner' (not only limited partner).

headings.title: Application to post-1987 domestic and foreign partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Applies the act (1985 H.B. 512 & 650 per asterisk note) to domestic LPs formed on or after and foreign LPs doing business after January 1, 1987.

headings.title: Election period for pre-1987 domestic limited partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Gives pre-1987 domestic LPs until January 1, 1989 to elect governance under the act or face § 359.691 sanctions.

headings.title: Filing procedure and fee for pre-1987 electing partnerships
headings.reviewNote: Specifies certificate filing requirements and fifty-dollar fee for electing pre-1987 partnerships.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text, 1985 effective date (1-01-87), and asterisk note on 'this act' (H.B. 512 & 650, 1985); tightened subsection 1 title; pre-1987 election deadline (1-01-89), § 359.691 sanctions, and $50 fee verified.

headings.title: Schedule of filing fees
headings.reviewNote: Sets fee schedule for certificates, foreign registration, amendments, cancellations, and lists.

headings.title: Military service fee waiver
headings.reviewNote: Waives initial formation filing fee for active duty military or Missouri National Guard general partners.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked against archived full text and history (1985–2014); filing fee schedule and active-duty/National Guard general partner fee waiver for subdivision (1) verified.
